name: AI Page & Blog Generator for Local SEO – Writrex
author: writrex

sections.description:
Writrex is an AI page generator and AI blog generator for WordPress, with an automatic SEO fixer built in. It builds complete local SEO landing pages and blog posts inside WordPress. Enter a service and a town, and about ninety seconds later you have a finished page with sections, a featured image, schema, internal links and SEO metadata written into your SEO plugin (Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress or The SEO Framework). Then ask the built-in AI agent, Ask Writrex, to check your whole site and fix SEO problems, with nothing changed until you approve it. It is free, with no credits and no caps. You just need a Google Gemini API key, and Google’s free tier covers text.

Built for local SEO, not for spam

Bulk-generated location pages earn a bad reputation when they are one page with the town name swapped. Writrex is built to avoid that. The Local Signals field feeds real facts about each area into the content, the overlap guard flags pages that would cannibalize each other, the quality checker scores specificity, and a mention cap stops the town name being repeated into nonsense. Used properly, you get pages worth ranking. The tools to tell the difference are in the plugin.

Automatic page generator, automatic blog generator and auto SEO optimizer

Writrex automates the slow parts of SEO work:

  • Automatic page generator: type a service and a town and the AI page generator writes the whole page, adds images, schema and internal links, and fills in your SEO plugin fields for you
  • Automatic blog generator: the AI blog generator turns a topic into a full, structured post with your chosen tone, audience and length
  • Auto SEO optimizer: one scan checks your whole site and lists every SEO problem, from missing meta titles to missing ALT text and broken internal links
  • Automatic SEO fixer: Ask Writrex prepares the fix for each problem, and you approve it with one click. Nothing changes on your site without your approval, and every change can be undone

Local SEO pages and blog posts

Enter a service and a location, and about ninety seconds later you have a complete page on your site: headings and sections, a featured image, structured data, internal links to your other pages, and the meta title and description already written into your SEO plugin. Every page is checked against Writrex’s own quality and content requirements as soon as it’s generated. New pages are saved as drafts for you to review by default. Choose “Publish Immediately” on the form and a page that passes the checks goes live straight away, while one that falls short on something important is held back as a draft so you can fix it and publish it yourself, or publish it as-is if you’d rather ignore the warning.

You bring your own Google Gemini API key. There is no subscription, no credit system and no usage cap inside the plugin. Generate as many pages and posts as your own Gemini quota allows.

What it does

  • Local landing pages: a service plus a town becomes a full page with hero, benefits, process, checklist, pricing panel, case study, FAQ and a closing call to action
  • Suggest local facts: one click finds real, checkable facts about your target area (what kind of place it is, landmarks, events, nearby towns), shows the sources, and lets you tick the ones you have confirmed before they are added to Local Signals
  • Choose your sections: switch any of those six optional sections off per page when a page does not need them
  • Blog posts: long-form posts with control over tone, audience, length and reading level, plus optional FAQ and CTA blocks
  • Editor buttons: generate and rewrite inside the Classic editor, the block editor and Elementor, on any content, not just pages Writrex made (switch on in Settings)
  • Metadata written for you: titles, descriptions and focus keyphrases pushed straight into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress or The SEO Framework
  • Structured data: Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList and WebPage schema, plus LocalBusiness details from your contact information
  • Quality scoring: every page is scored on readability, structure, specificity and repetition. Pages are saved as drafts by default; if you choose to publish immediately, pages that pass go live and pages that fall short are held back as a draft for you to review
  • Overlap guard: warns you before creating a page that would compete with one you already have
  • Internal linking: generated pages link to each other, plus a [writrex_related_pages] shortcode to build a hub page
  • Bulk Meta Fixer: finds generated pages with weak or missing metadata and rewrites it, with undo
  • Google Business Profile helper: ready-to-paste profile text and improvement suggestions (see below)
  • Color Customizer: match every generated page to your own palette
  • Images: Pexels, Unsplash, Pixabay and Magnific (formerly Freepik) for stock, Gemini (Nano Banana) and Pollinations for AI generated, with fallback between them
  • AI Visibility: choose which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others) may read your site, publish your schema in one feed for AI answer engines, and optionally log which AI bots actually visit

Ask Writrex, your AI agent inside WordPress

Ask Writrex is an AI assistant that actually knows your site. Ask it a question in plain English and it reads your pages, posts, images, menus, SEO fields and the live pages your visitors see, then explains what it found and offers to fix it. Every fix arrives as a change card with a clear before-and-after preview. Nothing on your site changes until you press Apply, and every applied change can be undone with one click.

Ask it things like:

  • “Analyze my whole site and show me the most important SEO issues.”
  • “Why is the Home page missing a meta title? Fix it.”
  • “Fix the missing ALT text on this page.”
  • “Make the phone number clickable everywhere on the site.”
  • “Make the header buttons rounded.”
  • “Give me five blog ideas that don’t overlap what I’ve already written.”

What Ask Writrex can look at

  • Your whole site at a glance: theme, SEO plugin, page builders, content counts and the latest SEO report score
  • Any page or post: SEO title and description, headings, images and ALT text, links, word count and block layout
  • The live page exactly as a visitor sees it, including headings and SEO tags printed by your theme, so it works from evidence rather than guesses
  • Your media library, menus and Additional CSS
  • A full SEO scan of your site, run on request

What Ask Writrex can change (always with your approval)

  • SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase and canonical URL, written into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress or The SEO Framework (or printed by Writrex if you have no SEO plugin)
  • Image ALT text
  • Page title, excerpt, slug and featured image
  • An exact piece of page text, a single block, or a heading’s wording and level
  • Links: re-point or remove links to an address across a page
  • Phone numbers and email addresses: turn plain text into clickable links
  • Site styling through Additional CSS (unsafe CSS is refused)
  • New draft posts and pages, which are never published without you

Built to be safe

  • The agent can only suggest. Applying a change always takes your click, on a separate, permission-checked step
  • Before applying, Writrex checks the page hasn’t changed since the suggestion was made, so it never overwrites newer edits
  • One-click Undo on every change, with WordPress revisions kept for content edits
  • Change History shows every change made through Ask Writrex, who approved it and when
  • A change that would leave a page with no H1 heading is refused outright
  • Pages built with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery and other builders are detected, and edits that could break their layout are not offered
  • It never edits PHP, theme files, plugins or the database directly
  • Respects WordPress roles: people can only approve changes they are already allowed to make
  • Instructions hidden inside your site content are treated as data and ignored

A pleasure to use

  • Full-screen chat with saved conversations, search, rename and delete
  • A floating Ask Writrex button on every admin screen, including the block editor, with an optional button on your website that only logged-in users with access can see
  • Answers stream in as they are written, with Stop, Regenerate and Edit
  • Choose your Gemini model and how hard it thinks (effort)
  • Preview on site lets you see a change on the real page before you apply it
  • Export any chat as Markdown, or copy it straight into another AI tool

SEO Reports

Scan your site for essential SEO problems: missing, too long or too short SEO titles and meta descriptions, missing or doubled H1 headings (checked against the live page), skipped heading levels, missing ALT text, thin content, broken internal links, links to unpublished pages, pages hidden from search or pointing their canonical elsewhere, and phone numbers or emails that aren’t clickable. Each report is saved with a site score, and every issue has a Fix with Ask Writrex button that opens a chat ready to sort it out.

Google Business Profile helper

A Business Profile screen writes the text for your Google Business Profile and suggests how to improve it. Enter your business name and town (add a Maps link or website as a hint if you like) and Writrex looks for your public listing, tells you what it can see, then writes:

  • A profile description that fits Google’s 750 character limit
  • A services list with short descriptions
  • Three post ideas for Google Business Profile updates
  • Polite reply templates for positive, neutral and negative reviews
  • A short list of practical improvements, or a comparison if you paste your current description

Writrex never posts to Google and never opens private account data. You copy the text into your own profile. It only uses facts you give it or that it finds publicly, and it will not invent awards, prices or reviews. If it cannot find your listing, it says so and gives general advice instead of guessing.

Bring your own API key

Writrex uses Google Gemini. Gemini has a free tier for text and a key takes about a minute to create at Google AI Studio. The setup wizard has a Connect with Google button that opens the key page, and Writrex checks the key as soon as you paste it, so you know it works before you save. Image providers are optional. Pexels and Pixabay are free for stock photos and Pollinations offers free AI images with a free account key. Gemini’s own image models are paid only (see the FAQ). A three-step setup wizard walks you through it on activation.

Writrex

Writrex is a separate plugin, sold at writrex.com, for running this at agency scale. It adds bulk campaigns and scheduling, WooCommerce product content, site-wide SEO auditing, link audits, Google Search Console integration, rank tracking, a content decay scanner, a template builder, reusable brand voice profiles, additional AI providers (including OpenAI and Claude models for Ask Writrex) and client reports.

Nothing in Writrex Lite is restricted, reduced, time-limited or disabled in order to sell it. Every feature listed above works in full, Ask Writrex included, with no license, no credits and no trial period.

External services

Writrex Lite connects to third-party services to write content and to source images. Google Gemini is required for content generation. Every other service is optional and is only used if you choose it in Settings. Nothing is contacted when the plugin is activated, and no service is contacted on the front end of your site: visitors’ browsers only load files from your own site. The plugin does not send anything to writrex.com, does not phone home and does not collect analytics.

Google Gemini API (required)

Provided by Google. Used to write all page and blog content, SEO titles and descriptions, FAQ answers and Bulk Meta Fixer suggestions, and optionally to create images with Gemini image models (Nano Banana), which need a billing-enabled key. Requests go to generativelanguage.googleapis.com.

Data sent, and when:

  • When you generate a page or post: the keyword, location, business details (name, phone, address, contact URL), services, prompt settings and any custom instructions you entered on the form.
  • When you use the editor buttons in the Classic editor, block editor or Elementor: the text you select or type and your instruction.
  • When you run the Bulk Meta Fixer on a generated page: that page’s title, its focus keyword and location, and an extract of its content, so a new meta description can be proposed.
  • When Gemini (Nano Banana) is your AI image source: an image prompt built from the page keyword and location.
  • When a Gemini API key is saved and you open the Settings page, or press a Refresh button there: a request for the list of models available to your key. Only the API key is sent, and the list is cached for six hours.
  • When you press a Test button in Settings: a short test prompt, to confirm the key and model work.
  • When you press Suggest local facts on Pages Automator: the target area and, if entered, the keyword. This request asks Gemini to use Google Search grounding, so Google may run web searches for them. The facts and their source links are shown to you and nothing is saved until you add them.
  • When you use the Business Profile screen: the business name, town, the optional Maps link or website, your services, and your current profile description if you paste one. The first request uses Google Search grounding to look for the public listing. The result is saved in your own database so it is there when you return.
  • When you paste a Gemini API key in the setup wizard or Settings: after a short pause, the key is sent to Google in a request for the first entry in the model list, only to check that it is valid. The key is not saved until you save it.
  • When you send a message in Ask Writrex (the built-in AI agent): your message, the earlier messages in that chat, the site’s name and address, and the site information the agent looks up to answer (for example page titles, SEO titles and descriptions, headings, links, image file names and ALT text, menus, custom CSS and SEO report findings). Page text is included only if “Send page text to the AI provider” is on in Ask Writrex settings; turn it off to send structure only. …
sections.installation:
1. Install through Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it. The setup wizard opens automatically.
  3. Paste a Google Gemini API key, add your business details and choose where images come from.
  4. Go to Writrex > Pages Automator, enter a service and a location, and generate your first page.
  5. Open Writrex > Ask Writrex (or click the floating Ask Writrex button on any admin screen) and ask it to check your site’s SEO.
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for anything?

No. The plugin is free and nothing in it is capped. You need a Google Gemini API key, which has a free tier for text. The one thing Google does not give away is image generation: if you want Gemini to create your images, turn on billing for your key. Free stock photos (Pexels, Pixabay) and free AI images (Pollinations) work without paying anyone.

Why does Gemini image generation fail with a “limit: 0” error?

Google does not include its image models (Nano Banana 2 Lite, Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro) in the free Gemini API tier, so a free key has an image quota of zero. Turn on billing for your key’s project in Google AI Studio and the same key starts working for images, at roughly $0.03 to $0.13 per image depending on the model. Your text generation stays the same. If you would rather not pay, choose Pollinations as your AI image provider or use a stock photo provider. Google’s older Imagen models were shut down in August 2026 and are no longer offered in Writrex.

Is this an AI page generator and AI blog generator?

Yes. Enter a service and a location and Writrex writes a complete local SEO page. Enter a topic and it writes a complete blog post. Both are saved to your site with images, schema, internal links and SEO metadata. Writrex Lite creates one page or post at a time. Bulk campaigns are part of the paid Writrex plugin.

Is there an automatic SEO fixer or auto SEO optimizer?

Yes. Ask Writrex scans your site, finds issues such as missing meta titles and descriptions, missing ALT text, H1 problems and thin content, and prepares the fix for each one. It is automatic in the sense that you do not write the fixes yourself, but it never changes your site on its own: you review the before-and-after preview and press Apply, and you can undo any change with one click.

Is there a limit on how many pages I can generate?

No. There is no daily limit, no credit system and no trial period. The only limit is your own Gemini API quota.

How do I get a Gemini API key?

In the setup wizard, press Connect with Google. It opens Google AI Studio in a new tab. Sign in with your Google account, click Create API key, copy it and paste it into Writrex. Writrex checks the key as you paste it and tells you straight away whether it works.

Which SEO plugins does it work with?

Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress and The SEO Framework. Page and post generation and Ask Writrex both detect which one you have and write the SEO title, meta description and focus keyphrase into its fields. If no SEO plugin is installed, Writrex prints the title and meta description itself.

What does Suggest local facts do?

On Pages Automator, it looks up facts about your target area on the web (for example what kind of place it is, landmarks, events and nearby towns) and shows them with their sources. You tick the facts you have confirmed are true, and only those are added to Local Signals. Nothing is saved or used until you add it.

What is the Business Profile screen?

It writes ready-to-paste text for your Google Business Profile (a description, services, post ideas and review replies) and suggests improvements. Writrex never posts to Google and never opens private account data. You copy the text into your own profile and check every fact before you do.

Does Writrex change my Google Business Profile?

No. It only writes text for you to copy. It cannot log in to Google or edit your listing.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. The editor buttons work inside Elementor as well as the Classic and block editors, and pages built with the Page Design option can be handed to Elementor to lay out yourself if you turn that toggle off (see “Can I use my own page layout instead?” below).

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Not in Writrex Lite. Generating AI content for WooCommerce products is a feature of Writrex, the paid plugin. Lite focuses on standard pages and blog posts.

Does it publish pages automatically?

Only if you ask it to. By default every new page and post is saved as a draft for you to review. If you choose “Publish Immediately” on the Pages Automator or Blog Automator form, Writrex checks the page against its quality and content requirements as soon as it’s generated: if everything important passes, the page goes live straight away; if something doesn’t, it is held back as a draft so you can fix the issue and publish it yourself, or publish it as-is if you’d rather ignore the warning.

Does it send my data to you?

No. Writrex Lite never sends anything to writrex.com or to us in any form. It does not phone home, has no tracking and collects no analytics. Your content and business details go only to Google Gemini (using your own API key) and to any image provider you choose to switch on, and only when you use a feature that needs them. The External services section below lists exactly what is sent and when.

Will the pages match my theme?

Yes. Generated pages sit inside your theme’s own header, footer and menus, on classic and block themes alike. With Page Design on, the page body uses Writrex’s section layout, and the Color Customizer lets you set every color to match your brand. With Page Design off, Writrex produces plain structured content that your theme styles like any other page, ready to lay out in the block editor, Elementor or WPBakery.

How is this different from a general AI writer?

A general AI writer gives you text to copy and paste. Writrex Lite builds the finished page inside WordPress: sections and layout, a featured image, Service and FAQ schema, internal links to your other pages, and the SEO title, meta description and focus keyphrase written straight into your SEO plugin. It is built for local SEO, so it uses real local facts you provide, warns you before creating a page that would compete with one you already have, and scores every page for quality before it can go live. And Ask Writrex reads your actual site, so its advice and fixes are based on your real pages rather than guesses.

Will this get my site penalized for doorway pages?

That depends entirely on what you generate. Pages that genuinely serve a different location or service, with real specifics, are normal SEO practice. Hundreds of near-identical pages are not. Writrex gives you an overlap guard, a quality score and a Local Signals field precisely so you can tell the difference. Use them.

Can I use my own page layout instead?

Yes. Turn the Page Design toggle off and Writrex produces plain structured content you can lay out yourself in Elementor, WPBakery or the block editor.

Can I turn off sections I do not want?

Yes. Features, Process, Includes, Pricing, Case Study and FAQ can each be switched off per page. For posts you can switch off the FAQ block, the CTA box, Article schema and metadata writing.

What is Ask Writrex?

An AI agent built into Writrex Lite. You chat with it like any AI assistant, but it can look at your actual site: pages, posts, SEO fields, images, menus, CSS and the live pages visitors see. It explains what it finds and suggests fixes as change cards you can apply, preview, do yourself or dismiss.

Will Ask Writrex change my site without asking?

No. Ask Writrex can only suggest changes. Every change waits for you to press Apply, is checked against the current version of the page first, is recorded in Change History, and can be undone with one click. It cannot edit PHP, theme or plugin files, and new posts it writes are saved as drafts, never published.

Does Ask Writrex cost extra?

No. It uses the same Google Gemini API key as the rest of the plugin, so you only pay Google if your own usage goes past Gemini’s free tier.

What does Ask Writrex send to Google?

Only what it needs to answer: your message, the chat so far, and the site information it looks up. You can switch off “Send page text to the AI provider” in Ask Writrex settings so it works from page structure only. Your API key, passwords and users’ emails are never sent. See External services below for the full list.

Does Ask Writrex work with page builders?

Yes, carefully. It detects Elementor, Divi, WPBakery and other builders, and it can still fix SEO fields, ALT text, featured images and site CSS on those pages. Edits to builder layouts that it cannot safely rebuild are not offered, so it will tell you what to change in your builder instead.

Who can use Ask Writrex?

Administrators, and Editors unless you switch that off in Ask Writrex settings. Anyone using it can only apply changes their WordPress role already allows them to make, so an Editor can’t change site CSS, for example.

What happens to my settings if I move to Writrex?

They carry across, including your Ask Writrex chats, SEO reports and Change History. Writrex reads the data this plugin writes and deactivates Writrex Lite on activation, so the two never run at the same time.

Does uninstalling delete my content?

No. Generated pages, posts and images are always left in place. Settings are kept by default too, so you can reinstall without reconfiguring. If you want a full cleanup, enable the delete-on-uninstall option in Settings before removing the plugin.

1.3.0

  • New: Business Profile screen. Enter your business name and town and Writrex looks for your public Google listing, then writes a profile description (within Google’s 750 character limit), a services list, three post ideas and review reply templates, with a list of suggested improvements. Nothing is posted to Google: you copy the text into your own profile. It never invents awards, prices or reviews, and says so when it cannot find your listing.
  • New: Suggest local facts on Pages Automator. One click finds real, checkable facts about your target area with source links, and you tick the ones you have confirmed before they are added to Local Signals.
  • New: Connect with Google button in the setup wizard. It opens Google AI Studio so you can create a free Gemini key in a few clicks.
  • New: your Gemini key is checked as soon as you paste it, in the setup wizard and in Settings, with a clear message if it is wrong, rate limited or cannot be checked.
  • Improved: the setup wizard’s first step now walks you through getting a key in three short steps.
  • Improved: Business Profile results are removed when “delete data on uninstall” is on. Your pages and posts are never touched.
  • Readme: new plugin name, short description and tags, a description that leads with local SEO pages, and an FAQ answer that lists every SEO plugin Writrex works with.
  • Privacy: the External services section now describes what Suggest local facts, Business Profile and the key check send to Google.

1.2.1

  • Fix: on sites using a page cache (LiteSpeed, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, Varnish or a CDN), Ask Writrex and SEO Reports could show out-of-date data, for example an issue reappearing after you pressed Ignore. Their requests are now never cached.
  • Fix: live page checks now refresh as soon as a page, its SEO fields, menus or theme templates change, so Ask Writrex never works from an old copy of the page.
  • Fix: applying or undoing a change in Ask Writrex now asks common page cache plugins to clear that page, so visitors and the next check see the new version straight away.
  • Fix: the floating Ask Writrex button no longer appears inside popups such as a plugin’s “View details” window, and it now sits below other plugins’ popups and overlays.
  • Improved: chats started from a page or an SEO Reports issue are now named after that page or issue, so they are easier to find in your chat history.
  • Readme: clearer answer on automatic publishing (pages are drafts by default), and new FAQ entries on privacy, theme matching and how Writrex differs from a general AI writer.

1.2.0

  • New: Ask Writrex, an AI agent inside WordPress. Chat with it about your site and it reads your pages, posts, SEO fields, images, menus, CSS and live pages, explains what it finds and suggests fixes. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
  • New: Ask Writrex can suggest changes to SEO titles, meta descriptions, focus keyphrases and canonical URLs (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, or printed by Writrex when no SEO plugin is active), image ALT text, page titles, excerpts, slugs and featured images, page text, single blocks, headings, links, clickable phone numbers and emails, Additional CSS, and new draft posts and pages.
  • New: change cards with before-and-after previews, Preview on site, Apply, “I’ll do it myself” and Dismiss. Every applied change is checked against the current page first and can be undone with one click.
  • New: Change History screen listing every change made through Ask Writrex, with Undo.
  • New: SEO Reports screen. Scan the site for essential SEO issues (titles, meta descriptions, H1 headings, heading order, ALT text, thin content, broken internal links, noindex and canonical problems, unlinked phone numbers and emails), save reports with a site score, and fix any issue with Ask Writrex.
  • New: live page checks. Ask Writrex and SEO Reports load the published page as a visitor sees it, so H1 and SEO tag findings reflect what your theme actually prints. A change that would leave a page with no H1 is refused.
  • New: floating Ask Writrex button and mini chat on every admin screen, including the block editor, with an optional button on the website for logged-in users who can use Ask Writrex.
  • New: chat history with search, rename and delete; streaming replies with Stop, Regenerate and Edit; Gemini model and effort picker; automatic fallback to another Gemini model when one is busy or rate limited.
  • New: export any chat as Markdown, or copy it for another AI tool.
  • New: Ask Writrex settings, including “Send page text to the AI provider” so the agent can work from page structure only, and whether Editors can use Ask Writrex.
  • Improved: page builder awareness. Elementor, Divi, WPBakery and other builder pages are detected, and only changes that are safe for them are offered.
  • Improved: the Writrex admin menu is reordered so related screens sit together: Dashboard, Pages Automator, Blog Automator, Ask Writrex, Bulk Meta Fixer, AI Visibility, SEO Reports, Settings, Color Customizer, Help Guide, Change History.
  • Fix: after a plugin update, browsers could keep showing old copies of the Ask Writrex scripts and styles. Asset versions now change whenever a file changes.
  • Privacy: the External services section now describes exactly what Ask Writrex sends to Google Gemini. Your API key is sent in a request header, never in the URL.
  • Uninstall: Ask Writrex chats, reports and Change History are removed when “delete data on uninstall” is on. Your pages and posts are never touched.
  • Translations: interface text now uses US English as the source language. UK English is available as an English (UK) translation.

1.1.0

  • New: AI Visibility screen: per-bot allow/block table for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others) with plain-English descriptions, written as a managed block in robots.txt alongside any existing SEO plugin’s rules.
  • New: schema aggregation endpoint at /wp-json/writrex/v1/schema-aggregate exposing the site’s Organization/WebSite and Writrex-generated page schema in one JSON-LD call for AI answer engines, discoverable via a link tag in the site head.
  • New: AI Visibility → bot hit logging and dashboard. Turn on a lightweight, privacy-safe log (bot name, timestamp, page path only, no IP address, no full user-agent string) of which AI crawlers actually visit your site, with a 7-day rolling hit count per bot. Automatically excludes known AI bots from WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache and WP Fastest Cache so their visits reach WordPress instead of being served a cached page. Off by default; the log is capped automatically at 7 days / 500 rows to keep the table small.
  • Fix: the Debug Log page and diagnostics recording no longer turn themselves on just because WP_DEBUG_LOG is enabled site-wide. They now follow only the Settings → Diagnostics toggle (off by default), which previously had no effect on sites already running WP_DEBUG_LOG.
  • Perf: the schema aggregation endpoint’s page scan now always runs in the background (wp-cron), never on a live visitor or crawler request, so a cache miss can no longer make that request wait on a full page scan. Corrected the bot hit log’s database index, which was ordered in a way none of its actual queries could use. Added light caching to the AI Visibility dashboard’s hit-count query.

1.0.1

  • Corrected the plugin description and FAQ: pages publish automatically once they pass Writrex’s quality checks, and are only saved as a draft when something important fails.
  • Added Elementor and WooCommerce compatibility FAQ entries.
  • Expanded plugin tags for discoverability.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.

  • Automatic SEO fixer: Ask Writrex prepares the fix for each problem, and you approve it with one click. Nothing changes on your site without your approval, and every change can be undone

Local SEO pages and blog posts

Enter a service and a location, and about ninety seconds later you have a complete page on your site: headings and sections, a featured image, structured data, internal links to your other pages, and the meta title and description already written into your SEO plugin. Every page is checked against Writrex’s own quality and content requirements as soon as it’s generated. New pages are saved as drafts for you to review by default. Choose “Publish Immediately” on the form and a page that passes the checks goes live straight away, while one that falls short on something important is held back as a draft so you can fix it and publish it yourself, or publish it as-is if you’d rather ignore the warning.

You bring your own Google Gemini API key. There is no subscription, no credit system and no usage cap inside the plugin. Generate as many pages and posts as your own Gemini quota allows.

What it does

  • Local landing pages: a service plus a town becomes a full page with hero, benefits, process, checklist, pricing panel, case study, FAQ and a closing call to action
  • Suggest local facts: one click finds real, checkable facts about your target area (what kind of place it is, landmarks, events, nearby towns), shows the sources, and lets you tick the ones you have confirmed before they are added to Local Signals
  • Choose your sections: switch any of those six optional sections off per page when a page does not need them
  • Blog posts: long-form posts with control over tone, audience, length and reading level, plus optional FAQ and CTA blocks
  • Editor buttons: generate and rewrite inside the Classic editor, the block editor and Elementor, on any content, not just pages Writrex made (switch on in Settings)
  • Metadata written for you: titles, descriptions and focus keyphrases pushed straight into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress or The SEO Framework
  • Structured data: Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList and WebPage schema, plus LocalBusiness details from your contact information
  • Quality scoring: every page is scored on readability, structure, specificity and repetition. Pages are saved as drafts by default; if you choose to publish immediately, pages that pass go live and pages that fall short are held back as a draft for you to review
  • Overlap guard: warns you before creating a page that would compete with one you already have
  • Internal linking: generated pages link to each other, plus a [writrex_related_pages] shortcode to build a hub page
  • Bulk Meta Fixer: finds generated pages with weak or missing metadata and rewrites it, with undo
  • Google Business Profile helper: ready-to-paste profile text and improvement suggestions (see below)
  • Color Customizer: match every generated page to your own palette
  • Images: Pexels, Unsplash, Pixabay and Magnific (formerly Freepik) for stock, Gemini (Nano Banana) and Pollinations for AI generated, with fallback between them
  • AI Visibility: choose which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others) may read your site, publish your schema in one feed for AI answer engines, and optionally log which AI bots actually visit

Ask Writrex, your AI agent inside WordPress

Ask Writrex is an AI assistant that actually knows your site. Ask it a question in plain English and it reads your pages, posts, images, menus, SEO fields and the live pages your visitors see, then explains what it found and offers to fix it. Every fix arrives as a change card with a clear before-and-after preview. Nothing on your site changes until you press Apply, and every applied change can be undone with one click.

Ask it things like:

  • “Analyze my whole site and show me the most important SEO issues.”
  • “Why is the Home page missing a meta title? Fix it.”
  • “Fix the missing ALT text on this page.”
  • “Make the phone number clickable everywhere on the site.”
  • “Make the header buttons rounded.”
  • “Give me five blog ideas that don’t overlap what I’ve already written.”

What Ask Writrex can look at

  • Your whole site at a glance: theme, SEO plugin, page builders, content counts and the latest SEO report score
  • Any page or post: SEO title and description, headings, images and ALT text, links, word count and block layout
  • The live page exactly as a visitor sees it, including headings and SEO tags printed by your theme, so it works from evidence rather than guesses
  • Your media library, menus and Additional CSS
  • A full SEO scan of your site, run on request

What Ask Writrex can change (always with your approval)

  • SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase and canonical URL, written into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress or The SEO Framework (or printed by Writrex if you have no SEO plugin)
  • Image ALT text
  • Page title, excerpt, slug and featured image
  • An exact piece of page text, a single block, or a heading’s wording and level
  • Links: re-point or remove links to an address across a page
  • Phone numbers and email addresses: turn plain text into clickable links
  • Site styling through Additional CSS (unsafe CSS is refused)
  • New draft posts and pages, which are never published without you

Built to be safe

  • The agent can only suggest. Applying a change always takes your click, on a separate, permission-checked step
  • Before applying, Writrex checks the page hasn’t changed since the suggestion was made, so it never overwrites newer edits
  • One-click Undo on every change, with WordPress revisions kept for content edits
  • Change History shows every change made through Ask Writrex, who approved it and when
  • A change that would leave a page with no H1 heading is refused outright
  • Pages built with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery and other builders are detected, and edits that could break their layout are not offered
  • It never edits PHP, theme files, plugins or the database directly
  • Respects WordPress roles: people can only approve changes they are already allowed to make
  • Instructions hidden inside your site content are treated as data and ignored

A pleasure to use

  • Full-screen chat with saved conversations, search, rename and delete
  • A floating Ask Writrex button on every admin screen, including the block editor, with an optional button on your website that only logged-in users with access can see
  • Answers stream in as they are written, with Stop, Regenerate and Edit
  • Choose your Gemini model and how hard it thinks (effort)
  • Preview on site lets you see a change on the real page before you apply it
  • Export any chat as Markdown, or copy it straight into another AI tool

SEO Reports

Scan your site for essential SEO problems: missing, too long or too short SEO titles and meta descriptions, missing or doubled H1 headings (checked against the live page), skipped heading levels, missing ALT text, thin content, broken internal links, links to unpublished pages, pages hidden from search or pointing their canonical elsewhere, and phone numbers or emails that aren’t clickable. Each report is saved with a site score, and every issue has a Fix with Ask Writrex button that opens a chat ready to sort it out.

Google Business Profile helper

A Business Profile screen writes the text for your Google Business Profile and suggests how to improve it. Enter your business name and town (add a Maps link or website as a hint if you like) and Writrex looks for your public listing, tells you what it can see, then writes:

  • A profile description that fits Google’s 750 character limit
  • A services list with short descriptions
  • Three post ideas for Google Business Profile updates
  • Polite reply templates for positive, neutral and negative reviews
  • A short list of practical improvements, or a comparison if you paste your current description

Writrex never posts to Google and never opens private account data. You copy the text into your own profile. It only uses facts you give it or that it finds publicly, and it will not invent awards, prices or reviews. If it cannot find your listing, it says so and gives general advice instead of guessing.

Bring your own API key

Writrex uses Google Gemini. Gemini has a free tier for text and a key takes about a minute to create at Google AI Studio. The setup wizard has a Connect with Google button that opens the key page, and Writrex checks the key as soon as you paste it, so you know it works before you save. Image providers are optional. Pexels and Pixabay are free for stock photos and Pollinations offers free AI images with a free account key. Gemini’s own image models are paid only (see the FAQ). A three-step setup wizard walks you through it on activation.

Writrex

Writrex is a separate plugin, sold at writrex.com, for running this at agency scale. It adds bulk campaigns and scheduling, WooCommerce product content, site-wide SEO auditing, link audits, Google Search Console integration, rank tracking, a content decay scanner, a template builder, reusable brand voice profiles, additional AI providers (including OpenAI and Claude models for Ask Writrex) and client reports.

Nothing in Writrex Lite is restricted, reduced, time-limited or disabled in order to sell it. Every feature listed above works in full, Ask Writrex included, with no license, no credits and no trial period.

External services

Writrex Lite connects to third-party services to write content and to source images. Google Gemini is required for content generation. Every other service is optional and is only used if you choose it in Settings. Nothing is contacted when the plugin is activated, and no service is contacted on the front end of your site: visitors’ browsers only load files from your own site. The plugin does not send anything to writrex.com, does not phone home and does not collect analytics.

Google Gemini API (required)

Provided by Google. Used to write all page and blog content, SEO titles and descriptions, FAQ answers and Bulk Meta Fixer suggestions, and optionally to create images with Gemini image models (Nano Banana), which need a billing-enabled key. Requests go to generativelanguage.googleapis.com.

Data sent, and when:

  • When you generate a page or post: the keyword, location, business details (name, phone, address, contact URL), services, prompt settings and any custom instructions you entered on the form.
  • When you use the editor buttons in the Classic editor, block editor or Elementor: the text you select or type and your instruction.
  • When you run the Bulk Meta Fixer on a generated page: that page’s title, its focus keyword and location, and an extract of its content, so a new meta description can be proposed.
  • When Gemini (Nano Banana) is your AI image source: an image prompt built from the page keyword and location.
  • When a Gemini API key is saved and you open the Settings page, or press a Refresh button there: a request for the list of models available to your key. Only the API key is sent, and the list is cached for six hours.
  • When you press a Test button in Settings: a short test prompt, to confirm the key and model work.
  • When you press Suggest local facts on Pages Automator: the target area and, if entered, the keyword. This request asks Gemini to use Google Search grounding, so Google may run web searches for them. The facts and their source links are shown to you and nothing is saved until you add them.
  • When you use the Business Profile screen: the business name, town, the optional Maps link or website, your services, and your current profile description if you paste one. The first request uses Google Search grounding to look for the public listing. The result is saved in your own database so it is there when you return.
  • When you paste a Gemini API key in the setup wizard or Settings: after a short pause, the key is sent to Google in a request for the first entry in the model list, only to check that it is valid. The key is not saved until you save it.
  • When you send a message in Ask Writrex (the built-in AI agent): your message, the earlier messages in that chat, the site’s name and address, and the site information the agent looks up to answer (for example page titles, SEO titles and descriptions, headings, links, image file names and ALT text, menus, custom CSS and SEO report findings). Page text is included only if “Send page text to the AI provider” is on in Ask Writrex settings; turn it off to send structure only. …
